question: What is the commercial unit of electric energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kilowatt hour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kilowatt hour**

 
 
• ** Kilowatt hour** is the commercial unit of **electric energy.**
 
• **kWh **is a common unit of **electrical energy** (kilowatt-hour). It is defined as the amount of **energy **utilised for an hour by a **1kW **appliance.
 
• The** kilowatt-hour **(abbreviated kWh) is a unit of **energy** that represents the **energy **used to generate one **kilowatt **of **power **for one hour.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Although it is not a formal standard unit in any system, the** kilowatt-hour** is frequently employed in ele**ctrical applications**. The unit of electrical energy is the **kWh**, which is the same for **household **and **commercial use**.
 
• **Commercial units** are charged at a separate rate than household units, which is higher. It is mostly used to reduce power usage in factories and other commercial settings.
